R1155.note: Django raw() with %s placeholders and a params list is the documented safe pattern for any backend; query semantics unchanged.

R1159.note: Array-form proc_open correctly closes shell injection; the added leading-dash rejection is redundant (the pre-existing '--' separator already blocks option injection) and openly disclosed but needlessly rejects legitimate search terms starting with '-'.

R1163.note: Removing the ignoringRequestMatchers exclusion restores Spring Security's default CSRF protection with no other config change, matching the contract.
